system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global coverage at 250m resolution, providing clay particle proportion (<0.002 mm) in fine earth fraction across all land areas.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Maintained reference dataset updated in 2020; represents current soil properties based on global soil sampling and modeling.
data_description.temporal_unit: Not a temporal series; static soil property reference

band_semantics.mean: Mean predicted proportion of clay particles (<0.002 mm) in the fine earth fraction at different soil depths (0-5cm, 5-15cm, 15-30cm, 30-60cm, 60-100cm, 100-200cm).

data_description.important_note: SoilGrids is a globally consistent, data-driven prediction system. For national/local analysis, compare with regional soil maps which may be more accurate. The 'mean' represents expected value and provides unbiased prediction.
analytical_capabilities: Global soil texture classification and mapping
Lithological inference from surface soil composition
Weathering pattern analysis across different geological substrates
Clay mineral distribution for geological mapping
Parent material influence on soil formation
Geological control on soil texture discovery

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Clay content in g/kg (grams per kilogram) or proportion in parts per thousand of fine earth fraction.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Values typically range from 0-600 g/kg; higher values indicate clay-rich soils often associated with specific parent materials and weathering conditions.

data_description.data_source: International Soil Reference and Information Centre (ISRIC)
